_note: Wired to the unified Rust binary at packages/codebase-rust/target/release/ai-architect-mcp. CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT resolves to plugins/codebase/ when installed via the agentic-ai marketplace; the relative path walks up to repo root then into the codebase-rust package. Falls back to 'cargo run --release' when the prebuilt binary is absent (first-run dev). The bash -c wrapper handles ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} expansion. See cf85cfc in cdeust/automatised-pipeline (2026-04-25).

args: BIN="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../../packages/codebase-rust/target/release/ai-architect-mcp" && if [ -x "$BIN" ]; then exec "$BIN"; else exec cargo run --quiet --release --manifest-path "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../../packages/codebase-rust/Cargo.toml"; fi
